description: Fix 6 verified issues from April 2026 audit before adding new commands. Replace naive PrintDiff with DiffPlex, upgrade SolutionWriter to create new files, extract shared helpers, standardize CLI options, add missing validation, and update stale docs.
ralph_instructions:
Work through userStories in priority order. For each story where passes=false: follow the TDD phase indicated in the story notes (BASELINE/RED/GREEN/REFACTOR). Verification uses `dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx` and `dotnet test RoslynTools.slnx -v minimal`.

## TDD Discipline (from bound)

### BASELINE: Before ANY code change
- Run `dotnet test RoslynTools.slnx -v minimal` — all existing tests MUST be GREEN
- If any test fails: STOP, fix it first, do not proceed

### RED Phase Rules
- Tests MUST compile and run (no compilation errors)
- Tests MUST fail for the RIGHT REASON (expected behavior missing, not import errors or typos)
- Verify the failure message matches the expected missing behavior
- If target class doesn't exist yet: create an empty stub that compiles (returns default/throws NotImplementedException) so tests fail on assertions, not missing types

### GREEN Phase Rules
- Write MINIMAL code to make tests pass — no more
- 100% line coverage on new code (uncovered code = delete it or file follow-up)
- All existing tests must still pass (no regressions)

### REFACTOR Phase Rules
- All tests must stay green
- Coverage must not decrease
- If coverage changes: investigate why
- No behavior changes — pure structural improvement

### Per-Story Workflow
1. BASELINE: verify all tests green
2. Execute the story's TDD phase
3. `dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx`
4. `dotnet test RoslynTools.slnx -v minimal`
5. `dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes`
6. If green: set passes=true, update progress.txt
7. If red: fix before moving on — never skip a failing test
